6.5.7 SchM_Switch
Purpose:
Initiate a mode switch. The SchM_Switch API call is used for send-
ing of a mode switch notification by a Basic Software Mod-
ule.
Signature:
[SWS_Rte_07255]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00215, SRS_BSW_00347
⌈
Std_ReturnType
SchM_Switch_<bsnp>[_<vi>_<ai>]_<name>(
IN <mode>)
Where here
<bsnp>
is
the
BSW
Scheduler
Name
Prefix
according
[SWS_Rte_07593] and [SWS_Rte_07594],
<vi> is the vendorId of the calling BSW module,
<ai> vendorApiInfix of the calling BSW module and
<name> is the provided (providedModeGroup) ModeDeclara-
tionGroupPrototype name.
The sub part in squared brackets [_<vi>_<ai>] is omitted if no
vendorApiInfix is defined for the Basic Software Module. See
[SWS_Rte_07528].⌋
Existence:
[SWS_Rte_07256]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00215
⌈The existence of a managedModeGroup association to a provid-
edModeGroup ModeDeclarationGroupPrototype shall result in
the generation of a SchM_Switch API.⌋
[SWS_Rte_CONSTR_09049]SchM_Switch API may only be used
by BswModuleEntitys that describe its usage ⌈The SchM_-
Switch API may only be used by BswModuleEntitys that contain
a corresponding managedModeGroup association⌋
Description:
The SchM_Switch triggers a mode switch for all connected required
(requiredModeGroup) ModeDeclarationGroupPrototypes.
The SchM_Switch API call includes exactly one IN parameter for
the next mode <mode>.
The IN parameter <mode> is passed by
value according to the ImplementationDataType on which the
